info.text:
Fidelity's ZERO funds charge 0%. Fidelity still made $37.7 billion in 2025.
Fidelity launched its ZERO index funds in August 2018 with a 0.00% expense ratio, sold only through Fidelity brokerage accounts.
Our math: on $10,000, a 0% fee costs $0 a year; a 1% fee costs $100.
Fidelity earns on parked cash, paid funds and managed money: $7.1 trillion managed at the end of 2025. Revenue grew from $24.0B (2021) to $37.7B (2025).
Sources: Fidelity annual reports 2022-2025; Fidelity fund releases and prospectus (2018); Bloomberg.
News and education, not financial advice.
